long_biography.plain_text:
Palaiologos's most consequential insurance venture was the investor-led acquisition of Alpha Insurance in Cyprus. Under the Altius name, the business provided life, health and general cover, selling policies through its own agents and Alpha Bank Cyprus's branches. He stayed involved as a major shareholder and guided the insurer's development.

Earlier, legal training in Athens and work at British insurance firms preceded senior leadership at Ethniki Insurance. Palaiologos also chaired the Greek insurers' association during several periods, giving him a role in industry representation beyond his own companies. He later co-founded AssetWise Capital Management and joined the board of Pantelakis Securities, where he also holds shares.
